# E0431: closure that can't run in parallel

`std.par` runs the closure on other threads, so it can't reach a `Shared` value. Read the shared value once before the call, and capture the copy.

- Rule: [`par.what-runs-in-parallel`](../../reference/14-tasks.md#par.what-runs-in-parallel)
- Reported at: the argument.
- Tier: `advanced`, checked in the `analyses` phase

## Example

This program makes the mistake:

```stilt E0431:5
use std.par
use std.sync

fn scaled(factor: sync.Shared<i64>, xs: List<i64>) -> List<i64> {
  par.map(xs, |x| when factor { factor * x })
}
```

This one is fixed:

```stilt
use std.par
use std.sync

fn scaled(factor: sync.Shared<i64>, xs: List<i64>) -> List<i64> {
  let f = when factor { factor }
  par.map(xs, |x| f * x)
}
```

## What the compiler prints

`stilt check` on [`E0431_closure_that_can_t_run_in_parallel.lt`](../../tests/diagnostics/E0431_closure_that_can_t_run_in_parallel.lt):

```text
── CLOSURE THAT CAN'T RUN IN PARALLEL ── E0431_closure_that_can_t_run_in_parallel.lt:5:15  [E0431]

This closure can't run in parallel: it reaches `factor`, a `Shared<T>`, which
only a `when` reads:

  4 │ fn scaled(factor: sync.Shared<i64>, xs: List<i64>) -> List<i64> {
    │           ────── `factor` is a `Shared<T>` from here
  5 │   par.map(xs, |x| when factor { factor * x })
    │               ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

`std.par` runs the closure on other threads, so it can't reach a `Shared` value.
Read the shared value once before the call, and capture the copy.
```

`stilt check` on [`E0431_record_that_holds_a_shared_value.lt`](../../tests/diagnostics/E0431_record_that_holds_a_shared_value.lt):

    │           ───── `scale` holds a `Shared<T>` from here
  7 │   par.map(xs, |x| x * scale.name.len())
    │               ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

`std.par` runs the closure on other threads, so it can't reach a `Shared` value.
Read the shared value once before the call, and capture the copy.
